english.headline: Gold Market Commentary: Where floor art thou?

segments.heading: October in review
segments.body: Gold fell in October, likely on asset rotation, de-grossing and Fed rate-path repricing.

segments.heading: Looking ahead
segments.body: The post-2011 downturn is a poor parallel for the current 25% drop from the January 2026 high. The conditions for gold to recover are much stronger. Our framework shows that we may be nearing an interim bottom.
